title: Better than expected
text: Better than expected. Canister could hold more,  but did pretty good on a 4 pet household.  Its not super heavy, which is also wonderful

product_metadata.title: BISSELL MultiClean Allergen Lift-Off Pet Compact Upright Vacuum with HEPA Filter Sealed System, 31259, Black/Silver
features: Every Purchase Saves Pets. BISSELL proudly supports BISSELL Pet Foundation and its mission to help save homeless pets.
Clean Pet Hair Anywhere. Slim foot and Lift-Off Technology provide versatile, 2-in-1 cleaning.
Compact Foot. Fits into tight places to effectively remove pet hair and debris in every corner of your home.
Tangle-Free Brush Roll. Cut the hassle, not the hair.
HEPA Sealed Allergen System. Traps 99.97% of dust and allergens*.
description: As pet parents we know pet hair gets everywhere. That’s why we engineered our MultiClean® Allergen Lift-Off® Pet Slim lightweight vacuum to be able to keep up with pet hair. It has a slim, compact foot to easily fit and clean in smaller spaces around your home, and 2-in-1 Lift-Off® Technology that transforms this upright vacuum into a portable canister vacuum. And there’s no need to worry about annoying pet hair wrap that happens on the brush rolls of other vacuums. This machine is thoughtfully crafted with our Tangle-Free Brush Roll, so you can cut the hassle, not the hair. MultiClean® Allergen Lift-Off® Pet Slim also has a One Touch Easy Empty™ dirt tank, so when you’re done cleaning, maintaining your machine is easy and mess free. And this vacuum doesn’t just clean up after pets, it also helps save them. BISSELL proudly supports BISSELL Pet Foundation® and its mission to help save homeless pets. When you buy a BISSELL® product, you help save pets, too. We’re proud to design products that help make pet messes, odors and pet homelessness disappear.
